g.text: Wealth agents prepare; professionals retain authority
Range, Arca and Perpetual reveal complementary patterns for expertise, handoffs and approved execution.

Range’s skill records reasons, required questions, exceptions and stopping conditions. An owner maintains it and a separate reviewer checks it. The planner reviews every recommendation before client delivery. Five to ten examples are a starting test routine, not sufficient release assurance.

Arca’s tax-payment illustration spans replies, approvals, trades and settlement. Long horizon means durable shared plans and event-driven resumption, rather than continuous model thought. Track who owns the next action, what event wakes the task and which approval is still required.

Perpetual describes typed interpretation, a validating compiler and immutable approved plans. Approval attaches to the exact outgoing payload; an unknown dispatch outcome goes to manual review. Historical Morgan Stanley, UBS and RBC disclosures remain useful preparation/knowledge examples with their original dates.
Sources: Range · Arca · Perpetual | Reviewed October 25, 2026
